title: 2 Chronicles Bible Quiz - Chapter 27
description: Ten questions on 2 Chronicles 27: Jotham's building works, his victory over Ammon, and how he became mighty.

questions.text: How long did Jotham reign in Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Jotham was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem.
His mother's name was Jerushah the daughter of Zadok.

questions.text: Whose example did Jotham follow in doing what was right in Yahweh's eyes?
questions.explanation: He did what was right in Yahweh's eyes, according to all that his father Uzziah had done.

questions.text: Which place does verse 2 say Jotham did not enter?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says that he didn't enter into Yahweh's temple.

questions.text: What does verse 2 say about the people during Jotham's reign?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says, "The people still acted corruptly."

answers.text: They moved to the hill country

questions.text: On which wall did Jotham build much?
questions.explanation: He built the upper gate of Yahweh's house, and he built much on the wall of Ophel.

questions.text: What did Jotham build in the forests?
questions.explanation: He built cities in the hill country of Judah, and in the forests he built fortresses and towers.

questions.text: Besides one hundred talents of silver, what did the children of Ammon give Jotham?
questions.explanation: The children of Ammon gave him one hundred talents of silver, ten thousand cors of wheat, and ten thousand cors of barley.

answers.text: Ten thousand horses with their chariots
Cedar and cypress wood from Lebanon
Great flocks of sheep and goats
Ten thousand cors each of wheat and of barley

questions.explanation: Jotham became mighty because he ordered his ways before Yahweh his God.

answers.text: Because he ordered his ways before Yahweh his God
Because he hired soldiers from Israel
Because he made an alliance with Assyria
Because the Ammonites served in his army

questions.explanation: Jotham slept with his fathers, they buried him in David's city, and Ahaz his son reigned in his place.
